AGGREGATION: Equal weight per event after 1:1 within-stratum matching. Strata are concatenated. Not a trade, not a costed return.
ALTERNATIVE: The two means differ. Two-sided. The sign is not pre-specified.
CLAIM: Anticipation of a scheduled FOMC statement or CPI release produces a signed drift in the Binance BTCUSDT perpetual log return over the 24 hours ending one minute before the release, relative to the same year, weekday and UTC hour on weeks with no such release.

PRECEDENCE: F1, F2 and F3 all not fired -> PROMISING_PROTOTYPE

FOMC.NOTE: Point-in-time status inherited from the pinned D11 official statements. Not re-audited here.

DEPENDENCE_MODEL: CPI releases are at least 647 hours apart and FOMC releases at least 984 hours apart, so same-family 24h windows do not overlap. Two CPI-FOMC pairs overlap (5.5h apart) and are kept. Planning sample size is the 94 ISO weeks, then divided by 2 as a dependence stress. Five years are a sign-stability gate, not the sample size.

FALSIFIERS.F2_TEMPORAL: the yearly mean difference shares the pooled sign in fewer than 3 of 5 years
FALSIFIERS.F3_PRIOR_WINDOW: On the 24h window immediately before the primary window, using the same matched control timestamps shifted back 24h, the placebo contrast is significant at alpha in the same direction, OR more than half of events lack a control whose prior-window log return is within 0.25 of the event's. Either condition means the primary difference is not specific to the pre-release window.

INFERENCE.CI: 95 percent normal interval using the permutation-null standard deviation of DELTA_24, centered on the observed DELTA_24. The interval is reported. The decision is the permutation p-value plus the conjunctive falsifiers.
INFERENCE.MATCHING: 1:1 without replacement inside each stratum, using scripts/research/discovery_sprint_03/common.py sample_matched_ids_per_cell

MISSING_DATA_POLICY: An event or its matched control with any missing 1m close inside the window is dropped and counted. If the dropped-event rate exceeds 0.05 or any year keeps fewer than 4 events, SUPPORT_PASS is false and the result is INCONCLUSIVE_DISCOVERY. No imputation.
MULTIPLE_TESTING_POLICY: One primary endpoint, one alpha. The five descriptive variants, S_GAP, the overlap-drop sensitivity and the placebo window are reported and cannot change the classification. Alpha is not split and is not relaxed.
NULL: After 1:1 matching inside YEAR x WEEKDAY x UTC_HOUR, the mean event-window log return equals the mean control-window log return.

OUTCOME_BLIND_GATE.RULE: EXECUTION_JUSTIFIED only if the calendar universe, digest and 1:1 control slots check out AND the two-sided 80% MDE at n = ISO_WEEK_N / 2 is at most 0.50 sigma. A larger conservative MDE is EXECUTION_INFORMATIONALLY_WEAK. A broken calendar is DESIGN_INVALID or BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_INPUT. Realized returns cannot change this state.

OUTLIER_POLICY: No winsorization and no outlier deletion in the primary statistic.
OVERLAP_POLICY: Overlapping event windows stay in the primary set. They are listed in OVERLAP_PAIRS. The primary permutation does not drop them. A descriptive sensitivity drops the later event of each pair and cannot change the classification.

POWER.ECONOMIC_BAR_MEANING: Half of one 24h-return standard deviation, the vol-scaled size of the equity pre-announcement drift. Not fit to C012.
POWER.N_PROVENANCE: Nominal count and ISO-week clusters come from the two calendars only. Variance inflation 2 is a stated dependence stress, not an estimated autocorrelation.
POWER.SIGMA_PROVENANCE: Stated scenario range for a 24h BTC log-return standard deviation. Not estimated from CORE_BTC and not from any C012 window.

PRE_CUTOFF_GAP_POLICY: All 11 CPI events with EVIDENCE_LEAD_HOURS > 720 stay in the primary set. Sensitivity S_GAP repeats DELTA_24 on the complement (CPI lead <= 720 plus every FOMC event) and cannot change the classification.
PRE_RET_DEFINITION: ln(close of the 1m bar that closes at WINDOW_END) - ln(close of the 1m bar that closes at WINDOW_START). WINDOW_END is T-1min. No bar at or after T enters.
PRIMARY_ENDPOINT: DELTA_24 = mean(PRE_RET_24 on events) - mean(PRE_RET_24 on 1:1 matched controls)
PRIMARY_SELECTION_RULE: Outcome-free. The event set is the card's named set, FOMC and CPI. The window is the longest card horizon for which every canonical CPI event is SAFE_FOR_W. Both facts are calendar facts. The other five card variants are descriptive and cannot decide.
